root_idea.summary: The root centers on taking guidance or a model from something and following or matching it.
root_idea.development: The lexical development extends from model-guided imitation and correspondence to the exemplar itself, measurement, and adherence to an established course. The record also preserves a separate specialized branch for first arrivals and an exceptional branch concerning the pleasant smell of meat.

qac_form_accounting.reason: A distinct Quran-attested Form VIII verb, normalized from the supplied imperative to the perfect citation form.
A distinct Quran-attested active participle, normalized from the supplied masculine plural form to its singular citation form.

senses.definition: To follow or imitate an exemplar, model, or established guidance.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran occurrence is an imperative directing the addressee to follow an established model or guidance.

senses.definition: One who follows or imitates an exemplar, model, or established practice.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran occurrence is a masculine plural active participle referring to those who follow an established example or practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An exemplar, pattern, or model for imitation; a person or thing taken as an example.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun naming the model or object of imitation, distinct from the derived act of following it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measure or standard of correspondence, especially the measure of a spear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression قِدَى رُمْحٍ, referring to its measure or comparative extent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An origin or source from which branches develop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the original from which derivative branches or offshoots proceed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To proceed according to an established course, or to travel in a straight and orderly manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical usage describing adherence to a settled manner of travel or conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first members of a group to arrive at or come upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the initial arrivals from a company of people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give off a pleasant smell, said of meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly exceptional lexical branch, marked as separate from the main model-and-following semantic family.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The exemplar and imitation branch supports the two Quranic following senses and is directly represented as قُدْوَةٌ.
Pointer-only entry directing the reader to فِدْيَهٌ; it supplies no lexical meaning for this root.
The first-arrivals meaning is represented as قَادِيَةٌ.

cautions: The Quranic verb is attested in the packet as an imperative but is displayed under the normalized perfect citation form اِقْتَدَى; the nominal is normalized from the supplied masculine plural active participle.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The Maqayis entry appends قِنْدَأْوٌ, glossed as a strong-backed, short-necked man, but its lexical relation to قَدَوَ is not established clearly enough to assign it as a meaning of this root.
